Weekly operating control

Data Hygiene

Each deterministic check states the problem, the decision rule, the detection method and the current count before anyone is scored.

Review rule → filter affected records → resolve or approve exception

Problem types and rules

Global snapshot from the embedded data. Counts overlap and must not be added together.

15 checks
Problem typeWhat we doHow we detect itCount
One name and email, two different Employee IDsKeep them as two entities. Employee ID is the source of truth; never merge people by name.Duplicate full_name + email combinations in employees.csv with different employee_id values.11
Employee missing from identity_map.csvExclude unresolved source evidence from scoring and request or approve the missing mapping.Employee email from employees.csv is absent from identity_map.csv.33
Employee affected by an ambiguous source loginDo not assign the evidence until the login resolves to exactly one Employee ID.The same non-empty email, Jira or GitHub handle produces multiple candidate Employee IDs.22
Raw source login not mapped to any employeeLeave source rows unassigned and add an explicit identity-map record before using them.Raw Jira, Asana, GitHub or email login has no Employee ID candidate in the identity registry.89
Secondary task handle ending in _xDo not infer ownership; add an explicit mapping for the second account.Distinct task assignee handles ending in _x are absent from the identity map.12
Employee missing required KPI evidenceReturn Insufficient data; exclude the person from scoring and complete-profile peer averages.No safely linked usable KPI record exists for the employee.55
Employee missing required delivery-task evidenceReturn Insufficient data; confirm the export, submission or an approved absence/role exception.No safely linked delivery task remains after bets, admin and 5/15 tracking tasks are excluded.77
Engineering employee missing reviewed-PR evidenceReturn Insufficient data; confirm review data or record an approved role exception.Engineering employee has no safely linked PR with review_approvals greater than zero.20
Employee missing a 5/15 updateFollow up weekly or record an approved absence; do not change the performance score.No safely linked row exists in weekly_5_15.csv for the employee.55
Department × seniority control group below 3 complete profilesFlag the benchmark for HR review; combine cohorts only under an approved role policy.Count complete profiles in each department × seniority group and compare with the minimum of 3.6
Merged PR with zero recorded approvalsExclude it from reviewed-PR activity and verify whether review data is complete.pull_requests.csv row has merged = 1 and review_approvals = 0.270
Repeated 5/15 text templateKeep 5/15 as cited context only; do not convert the text into a structured score.The exact same update_text appears in more than one weekly_5_15.csv row.40
Bet row with a non-informative statusKeep bets as planning context and exclude them from scored delivery.All task_type = bet rows have the same status value.327
Source evidence windows that do not alignDisplay the limitation now; align KPI, activity and 5/15 windows before production scoring.Compare source windows: KPI is quarterly, activity is four weeks and 5/15 is two weeks.3
Manager rating with no defined rating periodTreat it as a prototype assumption and require an explicit rating period in production.employees.csv contains manager_rating but no rating-period field.222
